upsert.funding: 🟡 Partially funded. Study covers surgery, postoperative MRI/care and infusions; owner pays pre-enrollment thoracic/abdominal screening and diagnostic brain MRI.

🟢 Fully funded. No cost for participation; all listed study-visit costs are covered.

🟡 Partially funded. Screening, study medications and required study visits/labs/imaging are covered; the study also provides a $2,000 surgical credit and up to $1,000 for study-medication complications.
🟡 Partially funded. The study covers initial staging, Palladia medication and associated dispensing/administration fees.
🟡 Partially funded. The study covers MRI(s), HIFU treatment, associated anesthesia, study biopsies and analyses.

🟡 Partially funded. The study provides $3,000 toward either the initial diagnostic workup or radiation treatment, depending on pathway, and covers trial-related follow-up care.
🟢 Fully funded. All study visits, procedures and trametinib are free; dogs completing the study also receive a $1,000 credit toward standard-of-care SCC medical expenses.
🟡 Partially funded. Initial screening, follow-up visits and the investigational product are covered.
🟢 Fully funded. Study treatment is free; owners also receive a $400 gift card after study completion.
🟡 Partially funded. WSU provides a $1,000 medical credit plus ICU/study-related medications and bloodwork; VRCCO provides a $1,500 surgery credit plus study-related ICU, bloodwork and medications.
🟡 Partially funded. The study provides a $1,500 credit toward surgical tumor removal and covers study-related ICU stays, bloodwork and medications.

🟢 Fully funded after screening. Sponsor covers all study-related procedures including FLASH-RT treatments, examinations, chest radiographs, laboratory tests, sedation/anesthesia and CT; the screening visit is owner-paid.

🟢 Fully funded study procedures. The study covers specified diagnostics after enrollment, theranostic infusions, laser treatment, hospitalization and study rechecks including imaging and laboratory testing.
🟢 Fully funded study procedures. Study-related diagnostics, treatment, hospitalization and specified rechecks are covered.
🟢 Fully funded study treatment. Study cancer-treatment costs are covered through Day 63, including treatment of study-related side effects.
🟡 Partially funded. Z-007 treatment through Day 63 and treatment of Z-007/biopsy-related side effects are covered; other owner costs should be confirmed with Tufts.
🟡 Partially funded. Study provides the oral drugs and vaccine and covers nearly all study costs; some bloodwork and supportive medications remain owner-paid.
🟡 Partially funded. Study provides the oral drugs and tumor vaccines and covers nearly all study costs; limited specified bloodwork/supportive medications remain owner-paid.
🟡 Partially funded. The study provides up to $5,000 toward study treatment and supplies the study oral inhibitors at no cost.
🟡 Partially funded. Investigational miR-10b therapy and associated MRI/CT imaging are funded; unrelated diagnostics and treatment remain owner-paid.

🟢 Fully funded after enrollment. Trial-associated tests, quasiorganelle treatment, hospitalization, blood/fecal sampling, imaging and treatment of trial-related complications are covered; the initial evaluation is owner-paid.
🟢 Fully funded. All study-related visits are covered at no cost to the pet owner.
🟢 Fully funded. All study-related visits are covered at no cost to the pet owner.
🟡 Partially funded. All study-related visits are covered, including up to $4,000 toward amputation.
🟡 Partially funded. Study provides screening and scheduled laboratory testing plus up to $4,500 toward chemotherapy, exams, diagnostics and medications for chemotherapy-related side effects.

🟢 Fully funded. All study costs are covered, including exam, bloodwork and medication (about $1,500 value), plus up to $3,000 for treatment of study-related side effects.

🟡 Partially funded. Grant funding is available for surgery and ECI therapy; confirm the current owner share with Missouri.

🟡 Partially funded. The investigational vaccine is provided at no charge; hospital visits, diagnostics and vaccine administration are owner-paid.

🟡 Partially funded. The study covers the anti-PD-1 drug and study-related tumor biopsies; owners pay for vaccines, exam, staging and other treatment costs.
🟡 Partially funded. Study covers CT, implant/anesthesia, histopathology and specified follow-up imaging, plus a $1,000 credit toward other costs.
